==Acquisition==
'''[[Skill quest]]s'''
*[[The Path to Revelations]] ([[Tarnished Haven]])

== Notes ==
* This skill only activates if you receive at least 1 XP from a foe death.
* The benefits gained can be identified by the dialogue bubbles above the character's head:
::{| {{STDT|#6A3}}
|- align="center" valign="top"
|- style="background:#ADA;"
! Boast !! Benefit || Activation chance (%)
|- align="center"
| ''"Buwahahaha!"'' || All [[condition]]s removed from self || 30%
|- align="center"
| ''"Kneel Before Your Master!"'' || Double XP gained || 20% 
|- align="center"
| ''"Knowledge is Power!"'' || [[Heal]]ed for 50 [[health]] || 20%
|- align="center"
| ''"You're No Match for My Brains!"'' || Gain 5 [[energy]] || 20%
|- align="center"
| ''"Is There Anything I Can't Do?"'' || [[Recharge]] all skills || 10%
|}

* Skills that require a [[morale boost]], such as [[Resurrection Signet]], [[Sunspear Rebirth Signet]], and [[Celestial skill]]s, are '''not''' recharged by ''"Is There Anything I Can't Do?"''.
* Experience [[scroll]]s stack with ''"Kneel Before Your Master"''.

{{anomaly|Unlike other skills without an activation time, this skill has the standard [[aftercast delay]] of {{3/4}} second and cannot be used while moving or activating another skill.}}

== Trivia ==
* The boast ''"You're No Match for My Brains!"'' is a quote from the movie ''[[w:The Princess Bride|The Princess Bride]]''.
* The phrase ''"Knowledge is Power!"'' was coined by [[w:Francis Bacon|Francis Bacon]] and subsequently became a pop-culture reference due to [[w:Schoolhouse Rock|Schoolhouse Rock]] and various [[w:Public service announcement|PSAs]] in the 80s and 90s which borrowed the term.
* The phrase ''"Kneel Before Your Master!"'' is a quote from ''[[w:Masters of the Universe (film)|Masters of the Universe]]''.
* This skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[{{PAGENAME}}/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
